title: iCloud sync don’t work
body:
I used to love this app, I have lifetime membership and all…but I’ve changed my iPhone and lost ALL my habits and progress of MONTHS! Tried to contact them and they told me that “maybe” the iCloud sync was not active before…BUT that’s not true because I had it active AND only the mood track was restored. Inside the app the iCloud sync doesn’t allow to select which information to keep or not, It’s just “enabled” or “disabled”. If the sync wasn’t active then I shouldn’t have the mood tracker either huh (?)
Rest is fine I guess :/

title: This amazing app is helping me grow personally
body: Hello, I just wanted to come here and leave a review, I never do this but this app definitely is changing my life for better. I couldn’t be much happier to be able to track simple habits like brush my teeth, have breakfast and even sleep properly.. or drink water. I’ve been dealing with depression and anxiety and those simple tasks have been a struggle for myself. Its costing me more and more effort as I’m loosing motivation, but with a tracker like this whose developers are so gentle and amazing, I can know be more aware of the things I need to do to have a better life and by time deal with my mental health. Thank you for thinking on people like me who needs any kind of support to make our life’s better, sending hugs ! And I totally recommend this app !

title: Amazing App + one million dollar idea please listen to me and make it true
body: It's an amazing app, it helps me a lot to keep track of my habits and activities, but I would love to have a scoring system where I can choose the number of points to determine the activities, so if I do an activity it rewards me with x amount of points, if I have to get up at 6:00 am because it's hard for me then I choose that that activity earns me 50 points if I do it, the points don't necessarily have to give you something, it could just be an additional function in the application that people like me, they can activate their want, it would be useful for people who have a points reward system to motivate themselves and do not want to create an excel spreadsheet to track how many points I have earned with a certain activity, everything would be in the same app and they would only have to add a calculator that adds up all the points of each activity, they can even be divided by categories, certain activities are from the health category, others from habits, others from skills, then each time I complete activities that are from a certain category, the points would be added points, it would really be very useful, personally I have certain activities that have 10, 20, 50 points, and if I reach a thousand points in a certain category I decide what reward I want, buy something, go to dinner, travel... whatever but anyway, excellent app and I would appreciate if you can make my idea come true it would really be very useful for many people, maybe if you want to give an utility for the points in the app you can unlock colors or different icons with a number of points… Idk just make it real please none app got it I’ve been looking everywhere😫
